units.source_text: “千重子小姐从小就很会挑选有京都特色的和服布料……

en.t: Miss Chieko has been very good at choosing kimono fabrics with a Kyoto character ever since she was little...

units.source_text: 这条腰带还没给她看过呢。

en.t: I still have not shown her this obi.

units.source_text: 不知为什么，我总觉得有点不好意思。”

en.t: I do not know why, but somehow I always feel a little embarrassed.
